item.title: Saikyou☆Angel Zerachiel!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kujilabo.
  • 発売日: 2023-10-28
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: さいきょー☆えんじぇる ザラキエル！
  • 英語名: Saikyou☆Angel Zerachiel!

别名

  • Ultimate Angel Zerachiel

あらすじ

Set in the religious city of Logres, the story follows Zerachiel, an angel sent by her deity to rescue a companion from imprisonment by a religious sect. However, she is defeated by a holy maiden named Effie and stripped of her powers, left for dead. After being rescued by a traveling priestess named Aries, Zerachiel vows revenge against the sect that betrayed her.
